name: BlurText-TS-TW
title: Blur Text
blurb: Text animates in with blur and opacity transition when scrolled into view.
description: Wraps text and staggered-animates each word (or letter) to fade in and blur-out with configurable easing. Triggered by scroll visibility via IntersectionObserver.
use_when: Body copy or headings need a polished reveal entrance as the page scrolls.
avoid_when: When prefers-reduced-motion is set — the animation continues regardless.
a11y: Text content is fully readable; uses motion/react for animation. No motion guard; runs for all users.
